newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DEL MONTE RESTRUCTURES, WARNS ON PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: DEL MONTE RESTRUCTURES, WARNS ON PROFITS.

text.p: South African food group Del Monte said on Friday that it expected a drop in its earnings at the half way and full year stages of the current year due to a restructuring and difficult trading conditions.

"As a result of these issues, a material reduction in earnings is expected at both the interim and year-end stage compared with the equivalent periods of the 1996 financial year," the firm said in a statement.
The firm said shareholders should exercise caution when trading in its shares until its interim results, due to be released in July, are published.
Del Monte added that a strategic review at the firm would see significant changes to the group's operations and as a result the 1997 figures will contain several one-off charges and adjustments.
"These changes, which will be described in more detail at the interim results stage, are a key part of a comprehensive programme to improve the future performance of the group," the firm said.
The firm also said that underlying trading had been weaker than anticipated at the time of the release of its previous year results.
The Del Monte group consists of Del Monte Royal Holdings Ltd , Del Monte Royal Corporation Ltd and Del Monte Royal Foods Ltd .
